crops.name: Spearmint / Peppermint
crops.companion_notes: Best in isolated hanging basket; aggressive runners can choke other roots. Great near tomatoes to deter aphids.
crops.soil_preference: Rich, moisture-retentive potting mix with vermiculite
crops.touch_grass_action: Snip top leaves just above leaf nodes to stimulate lush lateral branching and release invigorating aromatic oils.

crops.name: Coriander / Cilantro
crops.companion_notes: Pairs well with spinach and radishes. Protect from intense heat to prevent premature bolting.
crops.soil_preference: Well-draining, cool potting mix enriched with organic compost
crops.touch_grass_action: Harvest outer stems early in the morning when moisture content and essential oil concentration are at their peak.

crops.name: Baby Leaf Spinach
crops.companion_notes: Excellent companion to strawberries and radishes. Thrives in cool ambient temperatures and light frost.
crops.soil_preference: Nitrogen-rich, loose potting soil with high compost content
crops.touch_grass_action: Use the 'cut-and-come-again' method: pluck only the outer mature leaves, allowing the inner crown to continuously regenerate.

crops.name: French Breakfast Radish
crops.companion_notes: Natural root aerator. Perfect cool-season filler crop. Keeps cucumber beetles and flea beetles away.
crops.water_frequency: Alternate Days (consistent moisture prevents woody roots)
crops.soil_preference: Loose, stone-free sandy loam to allow round, unhindered root expansion
crops.touch_grass_action: Gently probe the topsoil with two fingers; when the reddish crown swells to 1 inch across, pull cleanly upwards for instant crunch.

crops.name: Balcony Cherry Tomatoes
crops.companion_notes: Legendary pairing with Sweet Basil (enhances tomato flavor and repels thrips). Thrives alongside Marigolds.
crops.water_frequency: Daily in hot weather (deep, bottom watering preferred)
crops.soil_preference: Heavy-duty organic potting mix supplemented with bone meal and perlite
crops.touch_grass_action: Inspect leaf axils twice weekly and pinch off non-fruiting sucker shoots with your fingertips to focus energy into juicy clusters.

crops.name: Thai Bird's Eye Chili
crops.companion_notes: Loves hot railing positions and high heat reflection from sunny balcony walls. Companions well with basil and oregano.
crops.water_frequency: When top 1 inch dry (slightly drought-stressed plants yield hotter chilis)
crops.soil_preference: Well-aerated potting mix with 20% coarse sand or perlite
crops.touch_grass_action: Give the main stem a gentle daily wiggle; the vibration mimics wind currents and dramatically improves indoor/balcony flower pollination.

crops.name: Butterhead / Romaine Lettuce
crops.companion_notes: Happy in the understory of taller trellised plants. Excellent next to chives and radishes in cool weather.
crops.soil_preference: Fluffy, moisture-holding seed-starting mix mixed with coco peat
crops.touch_grass_action: Harvest leaves right at dusk; daytime sugars concentrate in the foliage, yielding crisp, zero-bitterness evening salad greens.

crops.name: English Creeping Thyme
crops.companion_notes: Cascades beautifully over railing boxes. Extremely cold-hardy perennial that withstands winter dormancy and summer drought.
crops.water_frequency: When top 2 inches dry (very drought-hardy Mediterranean native)
crops.soil_preference: Gritty, lean cactus/succulent potting mix with excellent drainage
crops.touch_grass_action: Run your fingers briskly through the trailing foliage each afternoon to stimulate essential oils and check soil dryness.

crops.name: Genovese Sweet Basil
crops.companion_notes: The holy grail companion for tomatoes and peppers. Extreme heat lover; highly vulnerable to cold.
crops.water_frequency: Daily in summer (morning watering prevents fungal mildew)
crops.soil_preference: Warm, rich, humus-packed potting soil with good aeration
crops.touch_grass_action: Pinch the central flower spikes the millisecond they emerge to keep foliage sweet, tender, and profusely branching.

crops.name: Scallions / Spring Onion
crops.companion_notes: Exceptional companion to lettuce, spinach, and carrots. Year-round survivor that thrives in cold winter boxes.
crops.soil_preference: Loose, fertile loam with balanced pH and compost
crops.touch_grass_action: Snip green tubular shoots with kitchen shears 1 inch above the root crown; they will regrow endlessly up to 4-5 cycles!

crops.name: Ever-bearing Balcony Strawberries
crops.companion_notes: Loves hanging baskets where berries drape cleanly without touching damp soil. Pairs with spinach.
crops.water_frequency: Keep evenly moist (Daily in fruiting phase)
crops.touch_grass_action: Tuck straw or coco fiber under trailing fruit clusters to keep delicate berries warm and elevated above wet potting compost.

crops.name: Mini Sweet Bell Pepper
crops.companion_notes: Great companion to basil, carrots, and onions. Sturdy floor container plant that demands warm soil.
crops.water_frequency: Alternate Days (consistent moisture avoids blossom end rot)
crops.soil_preference: Rich organic compost mix with added calcium and perlite
crops.touch_grass_action: Insert a 2-foot bamboo stake next to the primary stalk and fasten loosely with soft jute twine to support heavy pepper yields.

Spring Kickoff.badge: 🌱 Spring Awakening: Lengthening Light & Early Shoots
Spring Kickoff.thermal_description: Gentle warming, mild night breezes, optimal root expansion without scorching heat.
Spring Kickoff.primary_focus: Fast salad greens, young strawberry crowns, awakening aromatics, and rapid radishes.
Spring Kickoff.water_rule: Moist soil check every 2 days; guard against damp chilly root rot.
Spring Kickoff.outdoor_action: Prep containers with fresh compost, sow early seeds at 0.5" depth, and position tender sprouts in morning light.

Summer Peak.badge: ☀️ Summer Peak: High UV Solar Surge & Thermal Masonry Heat
Summer Peak.thermal_description: Intense midday heat, high thermal absorption from concrete walls, rapid soil evaporation.
Summer Peak.primary_focus: Heat-loving nightshades (Cherry Tomatoes, Thai Chilis, Bell Peppers) and Mediterranean sun herbs (Basil, Thyme).
Summer Peak.water_rule: Daily morning deep-watering; protect shallow railing boxes from afternoon dehydration.
Summer Peak.outdoor_action: Mulch soil surfaces with 1 inch coco fiber or straw; inspect for sucker shoots and move delicate greens into mid-tier shade.

Autumn Harvest.badge: 🍂 Autumn Transition: Crisp Nights & Sweetening Greens
Autumn Harvest.thermal_description: Cooling temperatures, declining solar zenith angle, pleasant daytime ambient sun.
Autumn Harvest.primary_focus: Second-cycle roots (French Radishes), sweet baby spinach, scallions, and cold-conditioned herbs.
Autumn Harvest.water_rule: Reduce watering frequency to alternate days or twice weekly as evaporation slows.
Autumn Harvest.outdoor_action: Harvest the last of summer peppers, clear dead foliage, and plant cold-tolerant greens in warm mid-tier boxes.

Winter Resilient.badge: ❄️ Winter Resilient: Low-Angle Sun & Cold-Hardy Survivors
Winter Resilient.thermal_description: Short photoperiod, chilly balcony drafts, frost potential; high moisture retention.
Winter Resilient.primary_focus: Cold-hardy super-survivors: Frost-resistant Baby Spinach, Scallions, Winter Radishes, and dormant Thyme.
Winter Resilient.water_rule: Water sparingly once every 4-5 days during midday only; avoid wet roots during freezing nights.
Winter Resilient.outdoor_action: Cluster floor pots close to apartment walls for thermal radiation, shelter roots with frost fleece on windy nights.

South.recommended_focus: Fruiting crops, Mediterranean herbs, sun-loving trailers

South-East.thermal_profile: Optimal gentle warming without harsh late-day scorching
South-East.recommended_focus: All-around ideal microclimate: tomatoes, leafy greens, strawberries

East.recommended_focus: Salad greens, coriander, spinach, mint, strawberries

South-West.thermal_profile: Hot afternoon temperatures, high thermal radiance from walls
South-West.recommended_focus: Heat-loving chilis, peppers, thyme, basil, tomatoes

West.thermal_profile: Warm to hot late afternoon, potential heat stress
West.recommended_focus: Hardy herbs (thyme, basil), peppers, chilis; shade leafy greens behind

North-East.sunlight_quality: Mild Early Morning Sun & Bright Ambient Light (3-5 hrs)
North-East.recommended_focus: Leafy greens, spinach, mint, scallions, shade herbs

North-West.sunlight_quality: Late Afternoon Sun & Ambient Light (3-5 hrs)
North-West.thermal_profile: Mild day, brief warm evening window
North-West.recommended_focus: Radishes, spinach, spring onions, mint, partial-shade greens

zone_1.name: Zone 1: Railing & Hanging Baskets
zone_1.description: Mounted directly on top rail or hung from ceiling/overhang. Captures unobstructed sky and sunlight. Ideal for shallow-rooted trailers, sun-loving herbs, and hanging strawberries.
zone_1.best_container_types: Railing saddle planters, 6-inch hanging coco-coir baskets, trough boxes

zone_2.name: Zone 2: Mid-Tier Rail Grid & Wall Vertical
zone_2.description: Utilizes wall trellises, vertical felt pocket planters, or railing tier shelves. Sheltered from harsh winds, receiving filtered ambient light or direct morning rays. Perfect for daily cut-and-come-again herbs and leafy salads.
zone_2.best_container_types: Tiered ladder planters, 7-8 inch rectangular herb troughs, wall pocket units

zone_3.name: Zone 3: Floor & Deep Corner Containers
zone_3.description: Positioned firmly against structural corner columns and along floor perimeter. Anchors heavy pots, climbers, and deep-root vegetables where pot weight is safely supported and wind shear is lowest.
zone_3.best_container_types: 10-14 inch heavy ceramic/terracotta or fabric grow bags (5-7 gallon), deep root boxes
